Project.title: Project
Project.description: A portfolio project showcasing architectural or development work.

category.description: The category of the project (e.g., Commercial, Residential).

year.description: The year the project was completed.

role.description: The role of the company in the project.

image.description: The main image URL of the project.

gallery.description: An array of additional image URLs.

description.description: A detailed description of the project.

challenge.description: The challenge faced during the project.

createdAt.description: The time the project was created.

Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: A customer inquiry submitted through the contact form.

name.description: The name of the person inquiring.

email.description: The email address of the person inquiring.

phone.description: The phone number of the person inquiring.

company.description: The company of the person inquiring.

createdAt.description: The time the inquiry was submitted.
